correctness.rationale: Conditional on multinomial side occupancy, geometry gives the exact normalized mean in all 1-, 2-, 3-occupied cases, including empty sides. Uniform endpoint-order expectations and shoelace area justify the conditional formula. Two independent integral evaluations give the closed finite difference and the uniform-cube moment. Strict convexity and exchangeability prove strict Schur-convexity of the deficit for N>=3; triangle side constraints and explicit integration give unique equilateral maximum and unattained degenerate infimum. Exact rational counts: 75 equalities across three methods; independent arclength geometry simulations at N=3,5,8,15; endpoint expressions checked at 22 sizes. Computations corroborate rather than replace proof.

originality.rationale: The two highly pertinent accessible primary full texts were examined in the relevant introduction, theorem, moments and proof sections. The boundary-polytope result of Reitzner–Schütt–Werner is asymptotic in N and supplies neither exact triangular finite-N values nor an all-N Schur extremal theorem; Maesumi derives a law conditional on exactly one point on each of three distinct sides and does not study independent perimeter sampling of unrestricted N. Search results including mathematical finding indices, published primary sources and specialized tables did not identify equivalent statement/implication. Negative search is not proof of novelty; unindexed work remains a risk.
residual_risks: No bibliographic search proves absolute novelty; an unindexed earlier explicit formula or triangle extremal theorem may exist.
Some related abstract-only sources were not compared via their inaccessible complete text; their sampling definitions differ from the central model.

value.rationale: The question is a natural finite-sample metric statistic in boundary random-polytope approximation, where general primary literature emphasizes asymptotics. The all-N area law simplifies unexpectedly to a moment of three independent uniforms, and strict majorization supplies a complete, sharp triangle-shape classification with unique equilateral maximum and exact unattained degeneration minimum. This is a substantive structural improvement beyond a single numeric moment or a tiny bound.
